panel: Learning and gamified education products for FACT//DUEL

method.sampling: Purposive qualitative selection of actionable criticisms and positive counterexamples; not representative or frequency-estimating.
source_types: Public customer comments on official help
searches: Product plus reviews, energy, streak, hosting, pricing, AI errors, performance and navigation
Exact review titles and reviewer names
Official help for each relevant mechanic
inclusion: Concrete product experience relevant to FACT//DUEL
exclusions: Duplicate App Store rendering of the same review
method.assertion_rule: A review records an attributed experience. Official documentation verifies a mechanic only, not the incident or prevalence. Requirements are analyst inferences.
method.quote_policy: Observations paraphrased. Locator titles are short exact excerpts, not full titles; match with author and dates. Markdown citations use editorial labels. No review-body passages are quoted. Per-page source budgets were checked across both deliverables; repeated full review titles were removed.

limitations: All app versions are unknown; platform is recorded only when stated or evident from source context.
Reviewers and editorial authors are self-selected or selected by the platform. No complaint rates, prevalence, market-level rankings or retention effects can be inferred.

Trustpilot review listings were readable, but individual-review click attempts returned internal retrieval errors. One direct HTML request returned HTTP 403. Exact listing URL, reviewer, title and dates are retained instead of guessed permalinks.
Trustpilot listing pagination is mutable and can differ by crawl date or locale; reader may need to search the named reviewer/title.
The App Store review page repeats the same text; L12 is counted once. Its individual star value was not reliably extracted.
L13's November 2025 experience predates its September 2026 publication and current Brilliant help. It is historical context rather than evidence of a current interface defect.
L15 publication date was normalized from a same-day relative timestamp on 12 September 2026; its experience date is explicit.
L10 supplies no disputed item or set URL; neither its errors nor AI provenance were independently established.
Kahoot's billing-help discussion contains differently dated staff replies about annual educational plans and a monthly/annual toggle; no universal current no-monthly-plan claim is made.

Quizlet's subscription overview describes monthly Plus usage limits, while its Study Guides page describes unlimited guide access for Plus and Unlimited. These do not establish a universal cap or L08's exact test allowance.
No controlled learning study, device benchmark, full accessibility audit, logged-in product walkthrough or network-failure experiment was performed.
No proprietary implementation details, retention statistics or allegations of deliberate manipulation are adopted.

requirements.requirement: Uninterrupted core practice with recoverable progress
requirements.acceptance: Complete a declared practice set, explanation review and mistake retry without energy/ad/payment gates; survive refresh.

requirements.requirement: Auditable scored answers and propagated corrections
requirements.acceptance: Expose answer, explanation, source, question version and report route; trace affected matches.

requirements.requirement: Accessible controls and full player-screen questions
requirements.acceptance: Keyboard, focus, zoom, motion and own-device readability checks; show timer/scoring before start.

requirements.requirement: Distinguish activity rewards from demonstrated knowledge
requirements.acceptance: Separate XP from accuracy, reviewed topics and later recall; repeat material is not labeled new mastery.
Untimed practice and reminder controls; resume after a break without paid status restoration.
Room/readiness visible; preview player view; recover failed join without losing place.
requirements.inference_note: Network recovery is a proposed safeguard, not an observed competitor failure rate.

requirements.requirement: Transparent future entitlements and usable account recovery
requirements.acceptance: Show total price, duration, allowance and renewal; mobile account management and support route work.
Saved questions and mistakes have clear destinations; changed content shows targeted review guidance.
